title: The gold pot cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the gold pot on the counter with the winner's name on a tag as blocks. The owner asks who won. Wood says a crab. She says who caught it. He says the strip didn't ask. She says the strip should.

panels.composition: The cover: the gold pot on the shack's counter, a paper tag on its handle, the name as blocks.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a gold-painted crab pot on a wooden counter with a paper tag on its handle, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet and questioning a young man while a dog waits, black and white, no words
a laundromat owner in a cardigan, level, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood at the rack, setting it in. The tag on the cover, blocks. He didn't ask. Next year he will. The strip takes notes it doesn't show.

image.prompt: a young man placing a small booklet into a wire rack in a laundromat, thoughtful, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'The strip should.' The strip starts asking in 2001.
